input.provenance: Entirely synthetic nondispersive materials, not measured garnet, silica or any named material. g and MO thickness fitted to equal-amplitude circular transmission with pi/2 phase difference at 600 nm. PEC gap then fitted to zero returned Ex.
input.architecture: (H L)^5 MO (L H)^5; H,L quarter-wave dielectric layers; central axial gyrotropic defect
input.loss_stress: Demo adds +0.001i to the MO diagonal permittivity without retuning; synthetic sensitivity test, not an estimate of measured loss.
input.scope: Normal incidence, mu_r=1, identical lossless hosts, axial magnetization, laterally uniform planar layers; no 2D nanodisk array.

stack.basis: fixed laboratory x,y in both directions; e+=(x+i y)/sqrt(2), e-=(x-i y)/sqrt(2)
stack.reference_planes: front and back faces of the contiguous stack
stack.method: stable scalar circular-channel scattering-matrix cascade; no growing transfer exponentials
stack.model: exact planar axial gyrotropic multilayer, normal incidence, mu=1, identical lossless hosts
stack.zero_index_policy: analytic (1-exp(2 i k0 n d))/n limit; exactly zero-index circular channels are supported
stack.energy_note: Bare-stack material loss operators use incoming-minus-outgoing flux; independent volume-heating validation is separate.

mirror_system.basis: fixed laboratory x,y on both propagation legs; magnetization unchanged
mirror_system.energy_note: Material-loss operator is a flux difference; validation independently integrates volume Joule heating. The scalar mirror is an opaque absorbing termination, not an extra transmission port.
